violations.why: irq_husk (higher priority) can preempt irq_urchin between its increment and the read-back, so the read sees husk's value.
irq_husk can write v_wharf between urchin's read and its write of 0, so urchin's earlier read is stale.
v_lagoon++ is a non-atomic read-modify-write, and husk's write of 1 in between is overwritten (lost update).
urchin uses v_inlet as the array index at line 52 and reads it again at line 53. Husk can reset it to 1 in between, so the two reads disagree.
v_inlet++ is a non-atomic read-modify-write, and husk's write of 1 in between is overwritten (lost update).
